mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. I’m really glad you’re here. You know, sometimes the deepest wounds aren’t the ones we can see. Painful experiences can leave invisible marks—shaping how we see ourselves, how much we trust, and whether we believe healing is even possible. It’s easy to feel alone with those memories, isn’t it? But what if you could find a way through? Together, we’re going to explore the journey from woundedness to wholeness. And along the way, we’ll draw inspiration from Tammy Lang’s powerful book, Damaged Goods: Things You Must Know About Healing From Abuse. She doesn’t sugarcoat the reality of trauma, but she does shine a gentle light on the steps—sometimes small, sometimes hard—that can move us forward. We’ll talk honestly about shame, guilt, and those moments when you might feel completely isolated. But we’ll also discover the quiet strength in setting boundaries, practicing self-compassion, and finding your voice again. With Tammy Lang as our guide, we’ll start to see how even the heaviest pain can fade—and how transformation is possible, one choice at a time. So, if you’re ready, let’s walk this path together. There’s hope waiting up ahead, and it’s yours to claim.
